jobs.title: RF Test Automation Engineer (Software)
jobs.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an RF Test Automation Engineer (Software) to design, develop, and maintain automated software solutions for testing and validating advanced RF communications systems used in spacecraft and satellite technologies.

This role will focus on developing Python/C++ test automation frameworks, integrating RF laboratory instrumentation, and building software interfaces to control hardware, automate measurements, and streamline testing and validation processes.

You will work closely with RF, Avionics, Embedded Software, and Test Engineering teams to develop reliable, repeatable, and scalable testing solutions that support spacecraft hardware development, integration, and production.

As a member of the Test Automation team, you will take ownership of software development from initial design through deployment and troubleshooting, helping improve testing efficiency and reliability across next-generation spacecraft programs.

Required Qualifications:

Strong professional experience developing software in Python, with an emphasis on hardware test automation.
Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks for RF systems, electronic hardware, or communications equipment.
Hands-on experience using software to control RF laboratory instruments, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, or similar equipment.
Experience with hardware/software integration, instrument communication, and troubleshooting.
Understanding of RF measurements, signal chains, and automated hardware validation.
Ability to independently develop reusable, maintainable test software rather than solely executing existing test procedures.
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including debugging, version control, and collaborative development.
Ability to work onsite in Redondo Beach, CA, five days per week.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience programming in C or C++.
Experience with software-defined radio (SDR) platforms, particularly USRP.
Familiarity with RF instrumentation from Keysight, National Instruments (NI), or similar manufacturers.
Experience with SCPI, VISA, PyVISA, or comparable instrument-control interfaces.
Experience with RF characterization, calibration, and validation.
Background in wireless communications, RF modems, satellite communications, or aerospace systems.
Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, CI/CD, or automated regression testing.
Familiarity with GNU Radio, embedded Linux, or embedded software development.

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Developer to join our Robotics & AI Software team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work closely with experienced automation and software engineers to develop and implement innovative algorithms for task and motion planning plus computer vision in robotic systems. As a key member of our team, you will contribute to the design, development, and testing of software solutions aimed at enhancing the efficiency and reliability of robotic software algorithms. This involves symbolic task planning, robot kinematics, collision detection, optimization, and computer vision.

The Role

Develop and maintain software development best practices to ensure high-quality code, efficient testing, and timely releases.
Collaborate with other teams to ensure that our software integrates seamlessly with other software products.
Collaborate with senior engineers to understand project requirements and contribute to the development of software solutions for robot task and motion planning.
Design, implement, and optimize algorithms within our planning framework, leveraging your programming skills and understanding of robotics principles.
Assist in the integration and testing of computer vision software to ensure robustness and performance in real-world scenarios.
Document your work, including code, algorithms, user manuals, and procedures, to support knowledge sharing and future development efforts.
Stay updated on advancements in robot planning algorithms and technologies, and contribute fresh ideas and insights to the team.

Basic Qualifications

Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls
Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Robotics, or related field with 5+ years of professional experience.
Proficient in programming languages such as C++ and Python.
Strong knowledge of data-structures, algorithms, and design pattern.
Fundamental understanding of industrial robotics including manipulator kinematics & dynamics, robot trajectory generation, and communications protocols.
Expertise with search algorithms, optimization methods, and constraint satisfaction.
Experience with open source robotic planning and manipulation software packages such as MoveIt and ROS.
Knowledge of unit-testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including product managers & owners, engineers, and internal customers

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, or related field with 3+ years of professional experience.
Understanding of computer vision libraries such as OpenCV and PCL.
Experience using programming languages such as C#, TypeScript.
Explored using Generative AI in robotics.
Strong publication record and/or open source contributions in the field of robotics.

Environment

Hybrid

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels E05 - E06 as evaluated through our interview process.

E05 / Senior: $141,380 -$194.390
E06 / Staff: $163,270 - $224,500

Pay Range: $141,380 USD - $224,500 USD

What We Offer:

Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
The Role

We are seeking a Software Engineer I, Full Stack to join our product development team working on Incydr, our Insider Risk Management product.

In this role, you will work as a full stack engineer with an emphasis on the front end of the Incydr web application, building features that help security teams protect corporate data and reduce insider risk. You will implement user interfaces in React and TypeScript, while also contributing to the backend services and APIs — built primarily in Kotlin and Java and hosted on AWS — that power those experiences. You will consume and help design APIs, maintain a consistent, high-quality user experience, and collaborate with User Experience, Product Management, Information Experience, and other development teams to provide features that bring value to our customers and help them secure their collaboration culture.

AI-First Engineering at Mimecast

Mimecast is an AI-first engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations.

We're looking for engineers who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.

What You’ll Do

Implement full stack code for assigned projects — from front-end interfaces to backend services and APIs — starting with well-scoped pieces and growing toward owning small features end to end, with an eye toward supportability, testability, and a consistent user experience.
Write unit, integration, and system tests across the frontend and backend of your team's code.
Test, debug, and troubleshoot across the Incydr web stack, from the UI down to backend services.
Partner with teammates to ship end-to-end features spanning UI and services.
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and help manage deployment of services owned by the team.
Assist with production issues and escalated customer questions for the web application and services owned by the team.
Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to support production services and respond to incidents as needed.
Document code and review code and design docs from others.
Demo progress on team deliverables.
Participate in story mapping and authoring sessions.
Contribute to process improvement efforts within engineering.
Participate in design discussions and code reviews, asking questions, contributing, and accepting feedback.
Learn about new things and share that with your team and others.
Collaborate with teammates throughout the product development organization including product owners, UI/UX designers, QA analysts, technical writers, and customer champions.

What You’ll Bring

We're looking for engineers with established fundamentals and the aptitude to grow — we care as much about your ability to learn as your current skill set, and strong candidates will have experience across many of these areas without necessarily checking every box.

1-2 years of professional software engineering experience, with a full stack background and an emphasis on frontend development.
Experience with React and TypeScript fundamentals including components, props, hooks, etc.
Experience with modern HTML and CSS techniques.
Experience translating designs/mockups into functional, responsive user interfaces.
Experience with frontend testing frameworks (e.g. Cypress, Playwright, or similar).
Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating client-side applications with backend services; experience building or maintaining those APIs is a plus.
Exposure to backend languages such as Kotlin or Java, and to data repository technologies (e.g. PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch), is a plus.
Experience with object-oriented development, microservices, or multi-tier systems is a plus.
Familiarity with continuous integration and deployment concepts.
Experience with agile/lean development processes.
Comfortable taking ownership of deliverables as part of a team.
Comfortable working in a collaborative environment, both offering and asking for help when it's needed.
Comfortable working with non-technical staff.
Passion for building interfaces and systems that work well for users.
Able to communicate technical ideas to peers in written and verbal form.
Experience with design systems and web performance is a plus.

What We Bring

Join our Incydr Product Development team to accelerate your career journey, working with cutting-edge technologies and contributing to projects that have real customer impact. You will be immersed in a dynamic environment that recognizes and celebrates your achievements.

Mimecast offers formal and ‘on the job’ learning opportunities, maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members to sustain a healthy lifestyle, and importantly - working in cross functional teams to build your knowledge!

Our Hybrid Model: We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person:

Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning.
Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams.
Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm.
Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community!

The base salary range for this position is $100,000-$150,000 plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations due to a disability, or any other reason that may help you in your interview process, please let us know by emailing careers@mimecast.com.

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.

A Foundational Company

Rilla is on a mission to index the offline world.

Today, we’ve built the leading sales coaching software for organizations doing sales offline. We have over 1000 customers, including The Home Depot, KKR, Neighborly, and PulteGroup, using our product to enable AI sales coaching across their organization.

We are backed by Google Ventures, Bessemer Ventures, Crew Capital, and Broom Ventures, along with others.

We’re an in office team in NYC with builders who operate like high speed reinforcement learners. We obsess over our customers, move at a high velocity, are not afraid of failure, and look to maximize our real-world impact.

If you want to build the products and systems for how billions of conversations in the real world are captured and indexed, Rilla is the place to do it.

The Role

Rilla engineers architect and ship features across the stack at lightning speed. On a daily basis, you will build end-to-end workflows, take them to production, and solve real world problems across an out-sized scale.

As an early technical steward, you will raise the bar for code quality and decision‑making, setting patterns that cement a world‑class engineering culture as we scale. While the company 10×’s, your scope and ownership will grow just as fast—building the tools, mental models, and platforms that let both you and Rilla accelerate exponentially.

Do you describe yourself as "obsessive"? Do you aspire to be a founder or a leader in applying AI to the physical world? We believe Rilla is the best place — with the best peers — to learn how.

Technologies We Use

Different languages and frameworks, including React, React Native, Typescript and Python
Open-source technologies like Node.js, PostgreSQL, Turborepo, Lodash, and Zod
Industry-standard build tooling, including GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Spacelift

What We Value

An infinite learner. Someone who is relentless in their curiosity.
A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply care about delighting customers and solving real pains, not vanity metrics.
A winning attitude. You thrive with extreme accountability, learning as a team, and both giving and receiving rapid feedback.
Extreme empathy. Our customers are not tech companies. They live and work in the real world. Empathy is critical to arriving at correct solutions.
Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail, because it means you got a new opportunity to learn more.

What We Require

Strong coding skills with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages, such as Javascript, C++, Python, Rust, or similar languages.
Strong engineering prowess, ideally developed at start-ups.
Familiarity with storage and data processing systems, cloud infrastructure, and other technical tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to iterate quickly with teammates, incorporating feedback and holding a high bar for quality.

Don’t Work Here

Please Don't Join If You're Not Excited About

Building an AI product for an industry untouched by modern software
Constantly talking to and visiting customers in the field
Working ~60 hrs/week in person with some of the most ambitious people in NYC
Attempting to build a generational company, and the intensity required to do so

Our benefits aim to empower Rilla employees in removing roadblocks to achieving their life’s work. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Rilla.

Benefits

Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and supplementary food and drink

At PAX, you’ll work alongside a collaborative, forward-thinking team in a fast-paced
environment where innovation is encouraged and ideas move quickly from concept to
reality.
We’re looking for the Android Payment Application Developer is responsible for designing,
developing, testing, and maintaining Android-based payment applications for PAX
terminals. This role involves implementing user interfaces using Java and Kotlin, integrating
with payment device APIs and peripheral hardware, processing payment transactions, and
ensuring compliance with payment security requirements. The developer performs coding,
debugging, testing, code reviews, documentation, and ongoing maintenance while
collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and high-quality
payment solutions.
This is an onsite role in our Jacksonville office working Monday – Friday, 9:00am to
6:00pm.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Duties & Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain Android applications for payment
terminals.
• Implement application features using Java, Kotlin, Android SDK, and vendor provided payment libraries.
• Integrate with payment hardware, card readers, PIN entry devices, printers,
scanners, and other POS peripherals.
• Collaborate with product managers, QA engineers, UX designers, and other
developers to deliver high-quality software.
• Troubleshoot software defects, identify root causes, and implement effective
solutions.
• Create and maintain technical documentation for software design, implementation,
and support.
• Ensure applications meet performance, reliability, security, and maintainability
requirements.

• Deliver high-quality software solutions on schedule while meeting business and
technical requirements.
• Build scalable, reliable, and secure Android payment applications.
• Continuously improve application performance, stability, and user experience.
• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional and global teams to achieve project
goals.
• Stay current with Android technologies, payment industry standards, and software
development best practices.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, code quality,
and team knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Need
• 2+ years of hands-on experience developing Android applications using Java and/or
Kotlin.
• Strong knowledge of Android application architecture, Android SDK, and Android
Studio.
• Experience with SQLite, RESTful APIs, and mobile application debugging.
• Experience developing payment applications, POS systems is highly preferred.

code reviews, and testing.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional, and global team
environment.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or
equivalent professional experience.
• Mandarin language proficiency is a plus.

Who We Are
PAX Technology is redefining the future of payments—and we’re looking for bold thinkers,

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Platform
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Growth Platform builds the machine learning systems that help businesses discover and use the Stripe products that meet their needs. Our recommendations reach users across the Dashboard, email, onboarding, documentation, and AI agent interfaces. We combine an understanding of each business with models that decide which recommendation is useful, when to show it, and how to learn from the outcome.

Our work spans recommendation and ranking models, contextual bandits, agent-based recommendations, and the data and evaluation systems behind them. We build shared capabilities that product, marketing, and sales teams can use across Stripe. Success means helping businesses take useful actions and adopt products that help them grow, while keeping recommendations relevant and avoiding unnecessary messages.

What you’ll do

You will build and operate production ML systems that improve how Stripe recommends products, content, and next steps to businesses. You will own work from problem definition and feature development through training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Working with data scientists, engineers, and product partners, you will turn model improvements into measurable user and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Design, train, evaluate, deploy, and maintain models for recommendation, ranking, and personalized action selection across Growth Platform surfaces.
Improve contextual bandit and policy-learning approaches, including exploration, reward design, and how recommendations adapt to user context and feedback.
Build agent-based recommendation capabilities that use business context to identify relevant products and integration options, with evaluations that test recommendation quality and usefulness.
Develop reliable data and feature pipelines for training and inference. Improve data freshness, feature quality, and consistency between training and production.
Build reusable tooling for model evaluation, retraining, and safe rollout so the team can test and ship improvements faster.
Own the quality and operation of the team's ML components: write tested production code, monitor models and pipelines, investigate failures, and improve reliability, latency, and cost.
Design and analyze online experiments with data science partners. Connect offline evaluation to product adoption and incremental impact, with guardrails for dismissals, unsubscribes, and user experience.
Partner with product engineering to integrate models into recommendation delivery systems, and with ML infrastructure teams to use and improve Stripe's shared training, feature, and serving capabilities.
Work with product, marketing, and sales partners to identify problems that shared ML capabilities can solve, and make practical choices about where modeling adds value.

Who you are

You are a machine learning engineer with a builder mindset. You care about the business problem, the quality of the model, and what happens after it ships. You can move between modeling and software engineering, make practical tradeoffs, and take ownership of an ambiguous problem through production and measurement.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

3+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, or applied data science, with hands-on experience building and shipping ML models in production.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience writing maintainable, tested production code.
Practical experience designing, training, and evaluating ML models using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, or scikit-learn.
Experience building data or feature pipelines, proficiency in SQL, and familiarity with distributed data processing tools such as Spark or PySpark.
A strong understanding of statistics, model evaluation, and experimentation, including the ability to recognize data leakage and distinguish offline model improvements from business impact.
Experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging production ML systems, and evaluating tradeoffs among model quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
Ability to turn an open-ended business problem into a technical approach and collaborate effectively with engineering, data science, product, and business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with recommendation systems, ranking, personalization, or marketplace and advertising optimization.
Experience with contextual bandits, policy learning, causal inference, or off-policy evaluation.
Experience building and evaluating LLM applications, including structured extraction, embeddings, or recommendations grounded in user and business context.
Experience building reusable ML capabilities used by multiple products or teams, including training automation, feature systems, or model monitoring.
Experience with product growth, lifecycle messaging, or systems that balance short-term engagement with longer-term user outcomes.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $270,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

As part of the Enterprise Product team, the Enterprise Engineering team is responsible for bridging the gap between Stripe's core capabilities and the bespoke needs of the world's largest organizations. Our mission is to improve Stripe's product-market fit with enterprise users to win more deals and grow revenue, while giving every enterprise user an excellent experience as they onboard, activate, and grow their business with Stripe.

Enterprise Engineering tackles ambiguous, complex problems in a cross functional manner to deliver an exceptional Enterprise experience on Stripe. The key missions of the team is to 1) develop specialized Enterprise-grade product features for industry verticals 2) provide a configuration platform that streamlines onboarding Enterprise users onto Stripe and 3) deliver a consistently great and smooth experience when migrating sensitive data onto Stripe.

The team consists of full stack engineers who tackle this user goal through scalable and secure infrastructure, dashboard interfaces and internal administrative tools.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable and performant services and systems
Collaborate with other engineers across Stripe, as well as stakeholders across product, design, risk, legal, and operations
Build easy to use systems that streamlines adoption of Stripe and enable safe migration of data
Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation
Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

2+ years of industry experience shipping high-quality products
Strong analytical capability and ability to quickly ramp up in a new area, and tackle ambiguous problems
Enjoy and have experience building end-to-end solution, including full development lifecycle of deploying and maintaining this infrastructure
Experience with web software development
Hold yourself and others to a high bar when working with production systems
Take pride in taking ownership and driving projects to business impact

Preferred Qualifications

Strong collaboration and communication skills with both technical and non-technical counterparts
Able to reason clearly and move with urgency in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
Able to think outside of the box and be creative in designing and delivering the best solutions for our users
Enjoy a range of product development activities, from architecture design and planning, to user interviews, to writing code

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $190,400 - $285,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

jobs.title: Network & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Make your mark at Comcast -- a Fortune 30 global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, we reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. Become part of our award-winning technology team that turns big ideas into cutting-edge products, platforms, and solutions that our customers love. We create space to innovate, and we recognize, reward, and invest in your ideas, while ensuring you can proudly bring your authentic self to the workplace. Join us. You’ll do the best work of your career right here at Comcast. (In most cases, Comcast prefers to have employees on-site collaborating unless the team has been designated as virtual due to the nature of their work. If a position is listed with both office locations and virtual offerings, Comcast may be willing to consider candidates who live greater than 100 miles from the office for the remote option.)

Job Summary

Comcast is seeking an Engineer 2, Network Engineering to support the lifecycle management of critical core network infrastructure across one of the nation's largest telecommunications networks. This role is responsible for developing and supporting automation solutions that enable the deployment, augmentation, upgrade, migration, and decommissioning of core network devices throughout their operational lifecycle. The successful candidate will combine networking expertise with software development and automation capabilities to improve configuration management, compliance validation, deployment processes, operational visibility, and network reliability. Working closely with engineering, operations, and architecture teams, this individual will help accelerate the modernization and scalability of Comcast's core network infrastructure while ensuring operational excellence across multi-vendor environments.

Job Description

Responsible for supporting the engineering, automation, and lifecycle management of core network infrastructure. Contributes to the deployment, augmentation, modernization, migration, and retirement of critical network devices that support Comcast's core network environment.

Uses networking, software development, and automation expertise to design and improve platforms, processes, and tools that streamline device lifecycle activities, configuration management, compliance validation, operational reporting, and large-scale network deployments. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable automation solutions that enhance network reliability, operational efficiency, and service delivery.

This role is based in our Mt. Laurel, NJ office.

Responsibilities

Support the full lifecycle management of core network devices, including deployment, augmentation, upgrades, migrations, modernization initiatives, and decommissioning activities.
Develop and maintain Python-based automation solutions that streamline network device onboarding, configuration management, validation, and retirement processes.
Assist in planning and executing network infrastructure changes to support capacity growth, technology refreshes, and network transformation initiatives.
Build and enhance platforms that support large-scale configuration deployment, device lifecycle management, compliance tracking, and operational reporting.
Validate network configurations and perform audits to ensure compliance with engineering standards and operational requirements.
Analyze network telemetry, operational data, configuration information, and system logs to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.
Support execution of network device provisioning, software upgrades, hardware refreshes, migrations, and end-of-life decommissioning efforts.
Collaborate with engineering, operations, architecture, and software development teams to integrate automation and telemetry into operational workflows.
Assist in troubleshooting routing, connectivity, and network performance issues across large-scale multi-vendor environments.
Participate in the development of automation frameworks used for network validation, anomaly detection, testing, and deployment assurance.
Contribute to release management, CI/CD initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts supporting network automation platforms.
Monitor network performance and assist in identifying infrastructure enhancements that improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
Document network systems, lifecycle management procedures, automation workflows, deployment standards, and operational processes.
Participate in developing network engineering strategies and provide technical recommendations supporting future infrastructure growth and modernization.
Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
Regular, consistent, and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedules, and maintenance windows as required.
Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship. To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
2+ years of experience supporting network engineering, network operations, automation engineering, systems engineering, or related technical functions.
Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, subnetting, routing, switching, packet analysis, and OSI model fundamentals.
Experience supporting the deployment, operation, upgrade, migration, or decommissioning of network infrastructure devices in enterprise, service provider, telecommunications, or large-scale production environments.
Understanding of routing protocols including OSPF, ISIS, EIGRP, and BGP concepts.
Experience with Python or another scripting language used for automation and operational tooling.
Ability to develop scripts and tools that automate operational network tasks and workflows.
Experience working with network device configurations, operational datasets, telemetry, or log analysis.
Familiarity with Git or other version control technologies.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across multiple engineering and operational teams.

Preference For Candidates Who Also Have The Following

Exposure to AI/ML assisted tools or automation
Familiarity with network simulation or lab environments

Employees At All Levels Are Expected To

Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
Drive results and growth.
Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

LMI is seeking a Software Engineer to develop operational applications and AI-enabled workflows supporting U.S. Army planning and decision-making. This engineer will build applications using Palantir Foundry and modern software technologies, integrating enterprise data, conversational AI, and workflow automation to help operational users access information and make informed decisions.

This is a hands-on, full-stack engineering role involving direct collaboration with Army operational personnel, data engineers, and technical stakeholders. The engineer will contribute to application architecture, implementation, and delivery, with an emphasis on developing practical capabilities that solve operational problems.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Design, develop, and maintain operational applications using Palantir Foundry and modern software development frameworks.
Build user-facing interfaces, backend services, APIs, and integrations supporting operational workflows.

Implement AI-enabled workflows, including agent orchestration, tool integration, contextual interactions, and human-in-the-loop processes.

Active Top Secret clearance.

Below Are Additional Duties And Responsibilities

Execute the software design, development, and debug of multi-station automated assembly and test systems

Develop software design specifications from requirements
Apply software engineering best practices across controls deliverables: version control (Git - GitHub / Azure DevOps), branching/merging, code review, and configuration management

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Platform
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Growth Platform builds the machine learning systems that help businesses discover and use the Stripe products that meet their needs. Our recommendations reach users across the Dashboard, email, onboarding, documentation, and AI agent interfaces. We combine an understanding of each business with models that decide which recommendation is useful, when to show it, and how to learn from the outcome.

Our work spans recommendation and ranking models, contextual bandits, agent-based recommendations, and the data and evaluation systems behind them. We build shared capabilities that product, marketing, and sales teams can use across Stripe. Success means helping businesses take useful actions and adopt products that help them grow, while keeping recommendations relevant and avoiding unnecessary messages.

What you’ll do

You will build and operate production ML systems that improve how Stripe recommends products, content, and next steps to businesses. You will own work from problem definition and feature development through training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Working with data scientists, engineers, and product partners, you will turn model improvements into measurable user and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Design, train, evaluate, deploy, and maintain models for recommendation, ranking, and personalized action selection across Growth Platform surfaces.
Improve contextual bandit and policy-learning approaches, including exploration, reward design, and how recommendations adapt to user context and feedback.
Build agent-based recommendation capabilities that use business context to identify relevant products and integration options, with evaluations that test recommendation quality and usefulness.
Develop reliable data and feature pipelines for training and inference. Improve data freshness, feature quality, and consistency between training and production.
Build reusable tooling for model evaluation, retraining, and safe rollout so the team can test and ship improvements faster.
Own the quality and operation of the team's ML components: write tested production code, monitor models and pipelines, investigate failures, and improve reliability, latency, and cost.
Design and analyze online experiments with data science partners. Connect offline evaluation to product adoption and incremental impact, with guardrails for dismissals, unsubscribes, and user experience.
Partner with product engineering to integrate models into recommendation delivery systems, and with ML infrastructure teams to use and improve Stripe's shared training, feature, and serving capabilities.
Work with product, marketing, and sales partners to identify problems that shared ML capabilities can solve, and make practical choices about where modeling adds value.

Who you are

You are a machine learning engineer with a builder mindset. You care about the business problem, the quality of the model, and what happens after it ships. You can move between modeling and software engineering, make practical tradeoffs, and take ownership of an ambiguous problem through production and measurement.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

3+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, or applied data science, with hands-on experience building and shipping ML models in production.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience writing maintainable, tested production code.
Practical experience designing, training, and evaluating ML models using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, or scikit-learn.
Experience building data or feature pipelines, proficiency in SQL, and familiarity with distributed data processing tools such as Spark or PySpark.
A strong understanding of statistics, model evaluation, and experimentation, including the ability to recognize data leakage and distinguish offline model improvements from business impact.
Experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging production ML systems, and evaluating tradeoffs among model quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
Ability to turn an open-ended business problem into a technical approach and collaborate effectively with engineering, data science, product, and business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with recommendation systems, ranking, personalization, or marketplace and advertising optimization.
Experience with contextual bandits, policy learning, causal inference, or off-policy evaluation.
Experience building and evaluating LLM applications, including structured extraction, embeddings, or recommendations grounded in user and business context.
Experience building reusable ML capabilities used by multiple products or teams, including training automation, feature systems, or model monitoring.
Experience with product growth, lifecycle messaging, or systems that balance short-term engagement with longer-term user outcomes.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $270,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.description:
Overview

We are designing the grid of the future!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence.  For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid.   Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.  

Responsibilities

Join us in leading the
change!

We are seeking an experienced Power Systems Software Engineer
to join the EPE software team. You'll sit at the intersection of transmission planning and software: turning the way planners actually run studies into reliable, automated, cloud-based tools that utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers use every day.

Your primary responsibility is to design, test, and validate software that supports and accelerates transmission planning and interconnection assessment workflows. You will work closely with power system engineers, software developers, and product owners to define requirements, automate processes, and make sure our tools produce results that engineers trust.

How You Can Make An Impact

Domain requirements & product input: Translate transmission planning practice (study scopes, criteria, contingency definitions, mitigation logic) into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the development team.
Software design & testing: Design and test features that enhance utility-scale generation interconnection and transmission planning assessments, including steady-state, short circuit, and dynamic stability workflows.
Automation & programming: Use Python and related tools to automate study setup, execution, and post-processing, and to build tools that streamline transmission system studies and simulations.
Model & data management: Work with power flow and dynamics case data, contingency and monitored-element files, and supporting data to keep models and inputs clean, versioned, and reproducible.
Software validation & benchmarking: Benchmark tool results against established industry software and hand- calculated or reference studies; troubleshoot discrepancies to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance.
Collaboration: Partner with transmission planners, software developers, and cross-functional teams to develop and integrate solutions that energy development and planning teams need.
Documentation: Write clear methodology notes, user guides, and release validation reports that help engineers understand and trust tool outputs.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with a focus on power systems; a Master's degree is a plus.
- 4+ years of experience as a power systems engineer in transmission planning and analysis, generation interconnection, or renewable energy development.
- Hands-on experience performing power system studies such as steady-state (thermal/voltage, contingency analysis), short circuit, and/or dynamic stability.
- Working proficiency in at least one major power system analysis tool (e.g., PSS/E, PSLF, PowerWorld , TSAT/ DSATools , PSCAD, ASPEN, TARA).
- Solid understanding of the US transmission network and generation development, including ISO/RTO market structures, interconnection queue processes, and NERC TPL planning standards.
- Working knowledge of Python for scripting and automation of engineering workflows.
- Strong presentation and communication skills: able to explain complex technical topics to engineers, clients, and non-technical audiences.
- Excellent problem-solving skills, especially in identifying and resolving issues in power system simulations, models, and software results.

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong programming and automation skills in Python, including power system APIs (e.g., psspy ) and data libraries (pandas, NumPy).
- Experience with software testing frameworks and practices (e.g., pytest , regression/benchmark test suites) and version control (Git).
- Experience with Agile development, issue tracking (e.g., Jira), and writing requirements or user stories.
- Familiarity with cloud-based software development, distributed or batch computin g .
- Experience with SPP, MISO, PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, or other ISO/RTO interconnection or transmission planning processes (e.g., DISIS, cluster studies, TPL assessments).
- Familiarity with FERC Order 2023 and current interconnection reform.
- Knowledge of AI-driven or machine-learning applications in power systems.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, California College Guidance Initiative
jobs.description:
Data Engineer

California College Guidance Initiative

Full-Time
Remote Within California With Occasional Travel
All Candidates Must Currently Live Full-Time in California

Overview Of Role

The California College Guidance Initiative (CCGI) is looking for a data engineer to join the Cloud Infrastructure Team. As part of the team, you will be a key contributor in the expansion, refinement, and continued development of CCGI’s infrastructure utilizing Snowflake and Amazon Web Services (AWS), as well as continuing to build out our data analytics and engineering tools.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience building out data ETL/ELT workloads, including the testing, maintenance, and refinement of containerized workloads in cloud architectures. The Data Engineer should also have experience successfully scaling up an organization’s data intake from batch to streaming data, as well as automating data delivery. This person is comfortable working with data storage and can troubleshoot data accessibility via SQL, Python, shell scripting, AWS, Snowflake, and take on a leadership role in special projects when needed. Additionally, this person should have experience developing technical documentation and implementing security governance protocols.

While there are no direct supervisory responsibilities for this position, the ideal candidate will have proactively and successfully collaborated with other subject matter experts to move time-bound projects to completion. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience working with K-12 or education data and/or have an interest in large educational systems and the equity challenges students face when navigating such systems.

We work to solve large scale, system-level problems. You must be comfortable working with unknowns and ambiguous solutions, as well as passionate about promoting public education and advancing educational equity. This role reports to the Director, Cloud Infrastructure.

What Will You Be Doing?

Lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of batch and streaming ETL/ELT processes, including the development, refinement, and containerization of data loading and processing using event driven architecture and workflow orchestration.
Develop, containerize, test and maintain workflows within integrated development environments (IDEs) using AWS cloud services, Snowflake data warehouses, Python and SQL scripts, dbt, and shell scripts.
Review, redesign, and expand data models supporting data warehousing and self-service business intelligence architecture to create fully automated data pipeline(s) from staged or streamed data to organization of data warehouse objects and producing access via reporting, alerts or API access.
Design and implement data pipeline automation requiring Python scripting and SQL statements, integrating with systems such as Salesforce, Slack and AWS services using serverless, cloud servers and containerized systems.
Participate in meetings, research processes, requirement collection, data analysis, and collaborate with the key project collaborators.stakeholders of your projects.
Develop and maintain expert knowledge of CaliforniaColleges.edu data, systems, and business processes.
Continuously improve data pipelines and architecture by staying updated on industry trends and best practices.
Other duties as assigned by your supervisor.

What Technical Skills Do You Need?

Relevant BA/BS in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems, or another quantitative field.
Minimum of three (3) years of experience as a Data Engineer or a related role.
Ability to build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency, and workload management.
Advanced proficiency with cloud data warehousing analytical tools such as Snowflake, Redshift, Spark, Kafka, etc.
Expert SQL knowledge (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) and understanding of relational databases, query authoring and optimization, as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases.
Advanced proficiency using ETL tools like Jupyter Notebooks, dbt, Talend, etc.
Advanced proficiency with scripting languages like Python, Scala, R, etc.
Advanced proficiency building and optimizing data pipelines and data sets.
A successful history of manipulating, processing and extracting value from large structured and unstructured datasets.
Demonstrated ability to consistently develop strong technical documentation
Advanced certifications such as SnowPro Core, AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification, or AWS Certification, Solutions Architect - Associate are a plus
Experience working with K-12 data and/or education data is encouraged

What Intangibles Do You Need?

Strong data analysis and decision-making skills with the ability to take abstract brainstorming and generate concrete proposals for action.
Ability to advance projects without detailed supervision, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously
Experience supporting and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
Commitment to developing and maintaining trusting professional relationships, giving and receiving direct feedback, and modeling CCGI’s values.
Ability to write with attention to accuracy, audience, and concision within task tickets in project management tools like Jira.
Excellent verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate complex information simply with both technical and non-technical audiences.
A commitment to increasing educational access and equity.

More About The Cloud Infrastructure Team

This role will join a team of 5 experienced data engineers, working remotely across California, to oversee all of CCGI’s internal cloud-based data infrastructure. This includes overseeing the entirety of CCGI’s data warehousing, data engineering, and data orchestration systems, as well as user-centered data product design and development.

We are looking for candidates who bring experience with them to the role and are interested in joining a collaborative environment that encourages ongoing knowledge sharing and professional development. The Cloud Infrastructure team works regularly with other technical teams at CCGI as well as our student- and educator-facing teams to build sustainable and innovative technical solutions to advance our mission and goals. This role reports to the Director, Cloud Infrastructure.

More About CCGI

The California College Guidance Initiative (CCGI) is a legislatively authorized service provider to all California school districts as established in California Education Code Section 60900.5. CCGI is a state-funded nonprofit that works in partnership with California’s educational institutions—K-12 Local Education Agencies (LEAs), the California Community Colleges (CCC), the California State University (CSU), the University of California (UC), and the California Student Aid Commission (CSAC)—to smooth the path to college and career for all California students, especially those who have been underrepresented in higher education.

CCGI advances efforts to improve students’ transitions from K-12 to higher education by streamlining the college and financial aid application processes, while providing educators with the information necessary to inform data-driven counseling practices and real-time decision-making.

CCGI achieves this work through management of CaliforniaColleges.edu, the State of California’s official college and career planning platform for 6th-12th grade students. The platform is free for LEAs and serves as an infrastructure for postsecondary planning, data-driven student guidance, and the sharing of student records from K-12 LEAs to California’s public higher education systems and CSAC.

CCGI is housed at the Foundation for California Community Colleges but is an autonomous initiative with its own mission, goals, and leadership team.

CCGI is a positive, diverse, and supportive culture. At our core, we prioritize the needs of students above all else. Everyone at CCGI works remotely from home offices. We are all located in various parts of California and make use of tools, such as ZOOM, Slack, and Salesforce, to communicate and document our work. While some people regularly travel locally and/or statewide for required business meetings, we only occasionally conduct internal meetings in person.

The salary range for this position is: $120,000 to $145,000.

The Foundation’s benefit package currently includes paid holidays, sick and vacation leave; medical, dental, and vision insurance, Employee Assistance Program, a defined benefit retirement plan (CalPERS), and 403(b) and 457(b) retirement plans. Our excellent benefit package also provides $50,000 Basic Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment insurance coverage for eligible employees, Flexible Spending Accounts, Tuition Reimbursement, Voluntary Life Insurance, Pet insurance and more.

jobs.description:
Sr. Full Stack Engineer - Mobile, Web, & Devices

Location: Wichita, KS (on-site)

Salary: $120K - $155K base plus equity

Summary:

This position is with a customer-obsessed startup that will focus on the software their users utilize: mobile apps and web devices. This position is with a fast-moving team that leans heavily on AI and automation to build devices, applications, and platforms.

You'll spend most of your time specifying, orchestrating, and reviewing AI coding agents rather than hand-writing code. Your value is judgment: breaking problems into work agents can execute, writing precise specs, reviewing and evaluating output, and owning the architecture and safety calls agents can't make. That judgment comes from shipping hard systems for real users, which is why this role is senior-only.

Responsibilities:

Customer problem first
. Work starts from a real, validated customer need — a working demo or a clear spec grounded in what the frontline actually does. You keep that problem in view the whole way, not just the ticket.
Spec-driven, not prompt-driven
. You turn the validated requirement into structured specifications that drive what the agents produce. Ad-hoc prompting doesn't scale and isn't how we work.
You orchestrate; agents execute .
You decompose the work, sequence it, and keep the big picture; bounded agent execution does the building. You own the meta-level decisions — sequencing, architecture, tradeoffs.
Review and evaluation are the job
. You review generated code critically, catch the compatibility, safety, and performance failure modes that matter here, and build the tests and evals that gate quality. On old app and device versions that stay in the field for weeks, that scrutiny is the work.
Weekly releases behind flags .
Merge to main continuously; releases go out weekly behind feature flags — live but dark until product turns them on for a customer site.

Technical strengths (senior-level depth in one or more):

Mobile apps — React Native across iOS and Android; offline-tolerant, state and data-intensive apps.
Web portals and apps — Angular; admin consoles, real-time web apps, internal and customer-facing tooling.
Android Development / walt OS — AOSP platform work, HAL/JNI and native services in C/C++, custom Android images for custom, rugged hardware.
Radios & connectivity — audio routing for low-latency PTT, networking for handoffs in high-interference environments, mesh peer-to-peer networking.
Location & safety — GPS, Bluetooth beacons, ultra-wideband, motion sensors for precise tracking and safety alerting.

Requirements:

Several years of senior-level engineering with a track record of shipping production systems.
Demonstrable agentic development and automated testing experience — specifically around the common issues that client applications encounter such as power cycling, loss of connectivity, stale data states, etc.
Strong client-side judgment: backward/forward compatibility with app and OS versions that stay in the field for weeks, offline sync, and performance on constrained hardware.
Comfort in a monorepo with continuous delivery, feature flags, canary releases, and automated testing as the release gate.

Core competencies:

Customer obsession. You want to see the work in the user's hands. You measure yourself by whether the customer's problem is actually solved — not by whether the feature shipped.
Agentic judgment
. You know what to delegate and what to own. You write specs that produce correct results, you review generated code as rigorously as your own, and you never ship what you can't vouch for.
High agency. You take ownership and do whatever it takes to drive a problem to resolution, without waiting for direction.

Strong skills in .NET server-side development and object-oriented design

jobs.description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Citizen. This position requires an active U.S. Government security clearance, applicants who do not currently hold the required clearance will not be eligible for consideration. Employment for cleared roles is contingent upon verification of clearance status.

Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Please review the job details below.

Summary

Satellite imagery helps people map, monitor, and respond to what's happening across the planet, and our catalog API is how customers find and access it. We're looking for a senior backend developer to own that API end to end on a small, high-autonomy team, with real influence over its architecture and room to grow your scope.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes hard problems at scale: large geospatial datasets, both raster and vector, a high-traffic API, and performance work that actually matters. You'll design and build APIs and data pipelines in Python, tune performance against big Postgres datasets, and run it in the cloud.

What You'll Do

Own and evolve the catalog API, from design through production
Build and operate the data pipelines that keep the catalog current
Tune performance across the API and Postgres at scale
Ship safely and often, with automated tests and reliable deploys
Shape the architecture and technical direction alongside a small team

Minimum Qualifications

6+ years of backend development, building secure, scalable services in production
Strong Python and API design, with a framework such as FastAPI or Flask
Deep experience building and operating data pipelines over large datasets
Strong PostgreSQL, including performance tuning at scale
Fluent building and operating cloud services (AWS, GCP, or similar), with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation
Strong automated testing discipline
Applies AI to accelerate implementation
US citizenship required
Able to obtain and maintain a US security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Catalog experience with geospatial data or other large-scale archives
Familiarity with geospatial standards and tooling such as STAC, OGC APIs, PostGIS, and GDAL
Kubernetes or similar container orchestration
Zero-downtime deploys and service modernization

Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.

Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

$10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception
100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and
25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.

We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Software Engineer, Backend
to support our mission.

This role is based in New York or San Francisco
and open to those who are able to be in-office 3 days per week on a hybrid work model.

About The Team

Our team builds the insights and analytics experiences creators rely on to understand and grow their business on Patreon, along with the infrastructure that keeps those numbers accurate and trustworthy. We partner closely with Data Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Design to turn creator and fan data into features creators use every day.

About The Role

As a Backend Engineer on the team, you will build and own the services, APIs, and data flows behind creator insights. You will bring a strong backend foundation and the curiosity to work in the data layer: designing data models, building and maintaining pipelines and jobs, and making sure the data creators see is correct, fast, and reliable. You will work across the stack from ingestion to the product surface, and take on work that today depends heavily on Data Engineering.

In this role you will:

Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that serve creator insights at scale.
Build and maintain data pipelines, jobs, and models that feed insights features, in partnership with Data Engineering.
Improve data quality, monitoring, and performance so creators can trust what they see.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers to turn ambiguous questions into well-scoped solutions.
Drive technical design, write well-tested and maintainable code, and mentor teammates.

What you’ll need:

3+ years or 5+ years of experience in backend software development, building production services and APIs.
Strong programming skills in Python or a similar language, with good engineering practices (testing, CI/CD, monitoring).
Strong SQL skills and experience designing and optimizing relational data models (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Hands-on experience with data-intensive work, such as batch or streaming pipelines, scheduled jobs, event logging, or serving analytical data (e.g. Airflow, Spark, Kafka / Kinesis, dbt, a data lake or warehouse).
Care about data accuracy and reliability, including idempotency, backfills, and handling late or duplicate data.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills; comfortable partnering with product, design, and data teams.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or the equivalent.

Bonus if you have:

Experience with data quality, lineage, or observability tooling.
Experience building customer-facing analytics, reporting, or insights features.
Familiarity with metric design and data modeling for analytics and experimentation.
Familiarity with Elastic Search or OLAP

We hire talented and passionate people from different backgrounds because workplace diversity and inclusion is critical to our ability to serve creators worldwide. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t match with every bullet point outlined above, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re a creator at heart, are energized by our mission, and share our company values, we’d love to hear from you.

About Patreon

Patreon powers creators to do what they love and get paid by the people who love what they do. Our team is passionate about making this mission and our core values come to life every day in our work. Through this work, our Patronauts:

Put Creators First | They’re the reason we’re here. When creators win, we win.
Build with Craft | We sign our name to every deliverable, just like the creators we serve.
Make it Happen | We don’t quit. We learn and deliver.
Win Together | We grow as individuals. We win as a team.

Patreon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please let us know via email at accommodations@patreon.

Patreon offers a competitive benefits package including and not limited to salary, equity plans, healthcare, vacation leave, company holidays and recharge days, lifestyle stipends, learning and development stipends, patronage, parental leave and sick leave, and pension with an employer contribution.

Patreon offers a competitive benefits package including and not limited to salary, equity plans, vacation leave, company holidays and recharge days, patronage, parental leave and sick leave, and pension with an employer contribution.

The goal of this policy is to be intentional about the in-person time we spend together to strengthen the feeling of community at Patreon. Candidates hired into remote-eligible roles are not expected to meet the same requirements.
